sources: The move is about expanding addressable market and cross-sell opportunity.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: pale cyan. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: the platform band; a paper map.
Opens on the platform band, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The band unrolls into a paper map that spreads flat across the frame.
Ends holding on the map.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "CROSS-SELL".

COPY LIST: "CROSS-SELL". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The move is about expanding addressable market and cross-sell opportunity.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a refined 2D motion design style. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a flat, matte paper composition. The background is a solid, dominant block of pale cyan. In the center, a horizontal band of black-and-white halftone photographic paper with rough, white torn-paper edges is visible. A warm, consistent light source from the upper-left casts small, subtle shadows beneath the paper layers, giving a slight sense of depth to the flat matte materials. Immediately on the first frame, the horizontal band begins to transform, unrolling and expanding outward with a fast, snappy motion and a slight overshoot before landing stably. It unfolds into a large, detailed black-and-white halftone paper map that spreads flat to cover a significant portion of the frame. Concurrent with this motion, a small, rectangular cream-colored paper chip enters the frame, landing firmly in a safe margin. Printed on this chip in a large, extra-bold black sans-serif typeface is the clean, legible text "CROSS-SELL". The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5-second duration. At the end of the shot, the map and the headline hold a clear reading window, with a subtle, small looping movement—a slight rhythmic pulse of the paper layers—to maintain visual energy. An English narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, speaks directly to the audience: <d>[English] The move is about expanding addressable market and cross-sell opportunity.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the clear voice of the narrator. Beneath the dialogue, distinct diegetic sound effects of paper slapping against a flat surface and the sharp, tactile rip and stick of adhesive tape accompany the unrolling of the map.
